A plastic cover left on a polished table for months can print its pattern into the finish.

Some vinyl and rubber mats soften certain wood finishes where they press for a long time, more so in a warm room.

Lift covers and mats now and then, and keep a cotton cloth between a plastic sheet and the wood.

Try it this weekend: lift the cover and have a look underneath.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #homecare #shribazaar

Right-handed writers usually find it easier with the page turned a little to the left.

A slight tilt lets the forearm move along the line from the elbow, instead of the wrist bending at the end of every line.

Left-handers tilt it the other way. Try a few angles; every hand settles on its own.

Save this post for homework time.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #indianparents

Getting out of bed is the first lift of your day, and it often starts with a twist.

Swipe for four slow moves: bend the knees, roll onto your side as one piece, lower the legs while the arms push you up, then pause on the edge before you stand.

Stop if anything hurts.

How do the elders at home get up in the morning? Tell us in the comments.

#jointcare #wellnessathome #familycare #shribazaar

Look closely at a dried hard-water spot: its rim is darker than its middle.

As a drop dries, water flows out to its edge and carries the dissolved minerals with it, so they settle as a ring. A spilt drop of chai dries with a dark edge for the same reason.

Wipe a wet wall down after the last bath, and there is nothing left to dry into rings.

Save this post for your next bathroom clean.

#hardwaterstains #bathroomcleaning #cleaninghacks #homecare

Work on a stain from its outer edge toward the centre, not the other way round.

Working from the middle outward pushes the stain into clean cloth and leaves a wider ring. Working inward keeps it inside its own edge.

Put a folded cloth underneath, so the stain moves into it and not through to the other side.

Try it on the next mark that comes home.

#stainremoval #laundrytips #fabriccare #dailyuse

On a carved panel, spray polish runs into the cuts and dries pale.

On carving, mist the cloth, not the wood, and wipe. Spray straight onto the flat panels only.

Our Wood & Furniture Polish Spray is a beeswax spray for finished wood: almirah, palang, doors, mandir. Dust, mist lightly one section at a time, then buff off with a dry cloth along the grain. A soft, low sheen, and light scratches look less visible. Pack of 2.

The last puddle to dry on a terrace sits over its lowest spot.

Water gathers where the slope dips and stays there longest, and that is where hairline cracks and open joints show up first.

Walk the terrace the morning after rain and chalk the puddle outlines, so you know where to look once it is dry.

Try it after the next rain.

#monsoonprep #waterproofing #homerepair #dailyuse

One heavy bag on one side pulls the spine sideways, and the other shoulder hitches up.

Split the shopping into two half-full bags, one in each hand, and the body stays upright with the shoulders level.

Stop if anything hurts. How do you carry the vegetables home? Tell us in the comments.

#familycare #wellnessathome #indianparents #jointcare

Most stains at home belong to one of four families: protein, tannin, oil and dye.

Milk and sweat want a cold rinse from the back. Chai and coffee want a blot and a cool rinse. Ghee and hair oil want a blot, never a rub. Haldi and ink want treatment and a few washes.

Test any stain remover on a hidden seam first.

Save this post.

#stainremoval #laundrytips #fabriccare #homecare

White spots on a steel tap are minerals; orange spots are rust from iron close by.

The white ones are hard-water deposits left when drops of water dry on the steel. The orange ones come from iron: often a rusting pipe, a bucket stand or a razor kept nearby.

Look around the tap for the iron source and move it.

Try it this weekend.

#hardwaterstains #bathroomcleaning #cleaninghacks #madeforindia

Lean your head back on a high chair: the back of the neck softens once it stops holding it up.

Neck muscles only let go when the head's weight is supported. So before a slow neck massage, sit with your forearms on a table, or lean your head against a high chair back.

Our soothing massage gel is cooling and fast-absorbing, and dries without leaving skin sticky. For neck, shoulders, lower back and knees. Pack of 2 jars. For external use only.

#jointcare #wellnessathome #familycare #shribazaar

A wooden door that sticks in the monsoon usually frees up again by winter.

Wood swells across its grain and hardly at all along it. The boards widen, they don't grow longer, so the door binds at its edges.

A sealed finish on every face, including the top and bottom edges nobody sees, slows the moisture going in.

Which door in your home sticks in the rains? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #homecare #madeforindia

Make two fists, thumbs up, knuckles together: your left hand is a b and your right is a d.

Mixing up b and d, p and q is a normal stage for early writers. They are the same shape turned around.

Swipe for a memory hook for each pair: a bed, a pole and its flag, a doorway and a cup, and counting humps. Work on one pair a day, not all four.

Save this post for homework time.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #indianparents

Underarm yellowing on a white shirt builds up a little with every wash.

Sweat and deodorant that a normal wash leaves behind collect in the same place, wash after wash. See to the underarm and collar before the wash, not after the yellow shows.

Our All in One Fabric Stain Remover is a spot treatment for before the wash: wet the mark, cover it with the liquid, leave it a few minutes, then wash as usual. No scrubbing. It helps lift everyday marks. Pack of 2. Test on a hidden seam first.

#stainremoval #laundrytips #fabriccare #dailyuse

Hold a coin's edge against a crack: if it slips in, the gap is too wide to only seal.

A brush-on sealant is made for hairline cracks and fine joints.

A wider gap has to be filled with mortar or filler first, and the seal goes over the top once that is dry.

Try the coin test on your terrace this weekend.

#homerepair #waterproofing #monsoonprep #homecare

Why we sell only two tools.

BAGIYA is Grow & Guard. Some ground you are keeping, and some ground you want completely clear. Those are two different jobs.

GROW: a weeding rake head for the beds you are keeping. It lifts the weed between your plants and loosens the soil in the same stroke. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

GUARD: weed killer granules for paths, wall bases and corners you want fully clear. Sprinkle, water lightly, leave it. Never on lawns, beds or crops you are keeping. Wear gloves; keep away from children, pets and plants you want.

Not sure which one your ground needs? Ask us in the comments and we will tell you honestly.

Weeds on a path grow from the joints and edges, where rain water lingers longest.

After rain, the open surface of a slab dries fast. The joints between slabs, and the strip where the path meets the soil, stay damp much longer. That is where seeds settle and where roots find water, which is why a path goes green in lines.

So that is where BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go: sprinkle them along the joints and edges, water in lightly, and leave it. There is no need to scatter them across the whole surface. It clears whatever it reaches, so never use it on lawns, beds or crops you are keeping. Wear gloves, and keep it away from children, pets and plants you want.

Catch them young: three weeds as seedlings.

Congress grass (பார்த்தீனியம் · వయ్యారిభామ · പാർത്തീനിയം) starts as a flat rosette of deeply cut leaves pressed to the ground, before any stem rises. Gloves on, even at this size.
Nutgrass (கோரை · తుంగ గడ్డి · മുത്തങ്ങ) comes up as single shiny, stiff spikes, often in a line, because each one rises from a chain of tubers below.
Spiny amaranth (முள்ளுக்கீரை · ముళ్ళ తోటకూర · മുള്ളൻ ചീര) has smooth oval leaves and a reddish stem. The spines at the leaf joints come later.

Why young: a seedling has a small root and has not made seed yet. One clearing now spares you a bigger job later.

കള ചെറുതായിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ നീക്കാൻ ഏറ്റവും എളുപ്പം.

Save this post for your next walk around the plot. 🌱

#களை #കള #kerala #weedcontrol #bagiya

Weeds cannot grow where light cannot reach.

Most weed seeds need light on the soil before they sprout. Under a plant's leaf cover the soil stays shaded and few of them come up. So the weeds in a bed gather in the sunlit gaps: between young plants, along the bed edges, and wherever a plant was pulled out and the soil was left bare.

जहाँ धूप नहीं पहुँचती, वहाँ खरपतवार नहीं उगते।

Where do weeds come up first in your bed: 1 between young plants, 2 at the edges, 3 where a plant was pulled out? Tell us in the comments.

#बागवानी #weeding #terracegarden #growandguard

Bending to weed puts the whole job on your lower back. Standing moves it to the arms and legs.

With a khurpi you fold at the waist for every single weed, and your lower back holds you there the whole time. With a toothed head on a pole you stay upright: the teeth go into the soil ahead of you, and the pull comes from your arms and a step back.

The BAGIYA weeding rake head has five pointed carbon-steel teeth. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

झुककर नहीं, खड़े होकर निराई।

Which do you use today: khurpi or a long-handled tool? Tell us in the comments.

#बागवानी #weeding #gardeningindia #growandguard

The weed that leaves your fingers sticky.

Asian spider flower (Cleome viscosa) comes up on open ground, roadsides and plot edges after the rains. Its leaves and stems are covered in sticky glandular hairs with a sharp mustard-like smell. Look for leaves split into 3 to 5 leaflets like a hand, small yellow flowers at the tip, and long thin pods packed with tiny seeds. Clear it with gloves on, before the pods ripen.

தொட்டால் விரல் ஒட்டும் களை.

Send this to whoever clears your plot, so they know it by sight. 🌱

#களை #tamilnadu #weedidentification #bagiya

Five jobs a toothed rake does in a bed, and weeding is only one of them.

1. Lift weeds from between your plants: teeth under the weed, pull toward you.
2. Break up clods after digging, so the seed bed is fine and even.
3. Mix compost or manure into the top few cm instead of leaving it on the surface.
4. Level the bed before sowing: pull the high bits into the low bits.
5. Draw a shallow seed furrow with one corner tooth.

The BAGIYA weeding rake head: five pointed carbon-steel teeth, 20 cm wide. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

एक औज़ार, पाँच काम।

Sowing soon? Save this post.

#kitchengarden #gardeningtools #terracegarden #bagiya

Seeds land where the wind slows down.

Wind-blown seeds drop out of the air wherever it is checked: in corners, at the foot of steps, behind a gate, on the sheltered side of a wall. Those are the same places dry leaves pile up. That is why the same corners fill with weeds every year, while open ground stays thinner.

గాలి ఆగే చోటే విత్తనాలు దిగుతాయి.

Where do weeds collect at your place: 1 corners, 2 foot of the steps, 3 behind the gate? Tell us in the comments.

#కలుపు #telangana #andhrapradesh #weedcontrol #growandguard

After the rains, the soil stays soft for a few weeks. It is the easiest weeding of the year.

Moist soil lets a root slide out whole. Once the winter sun dries the bed hard, the same weed snaps off at the surface and the root stays in the ground to come back.

The BAGIYA 5-Teeth Weeding Rake Head is made for these weeks: five pointed carbon-steel teeth, 20 cm wide. Dig in, pull toward you and shake off the soil. The weed lifts out and the bed loosens in the same stroke, between the plants you are keeping. It is the head only: the handle is not included, and it fits a standard wooden pole.

बारिश के बाद मिट्टी नरम है — अभी निराई करें।

Full product details are at the link in bio. 🌱

#kitchengarden #gardeningtools #बागवानी #bagiya

The monsoon's last weeks leave the year's thickest growth along boundaries and gates.

Months of rain feed every gap at the foot of the compound wall, around the gate and along the path edge. As the rains end, that growth is at its fullest, so the ground you want clear needs attention now.

For ground you want completely cleared, BAGIYA Weed Killer Granules go dry onto the soil at the base: sprinkle, water lightly, leave it. It clears whatever it reaches, so never use it on lawns, beds or crops you are keeping. Wear gloves, and keep it away from children, pets and plants you want.

Clearing the boundary soon? Save this post.

Doob, motha or gajar ghaas: which one fights back hardest in your bed?

1. Doob grass (दूब): runners creep along the surface and put down roots at every joint.
2. Nutgrass (मोथा): pull the top and it grows back from small tubers below the soil.
3. Congress grass (गाजर घास): a deep tap root. Gloves on, never bare hands.

आपकी क्यारी में सबसे ज़िद्दी कौन?

1, 2 or 3? Tell us in the comments, and which state you garden in.

Fingertips held right at a pencil's point cover the very letter being written.

That is why a child often tilts the head sideways to see the line.

A grip a finger-width or two above the sharpened part leaves the line in view. Every hand settles in its own way; this is just one small thing to watch for.

Save this post for homework time.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #shribazaar

Hard-water film sits on light tiles too; on dark tiles it simply shows as a haze.

Our Bathroom & Tile Stain Remover is a ready-to-use spray for hard-water yellowing and rust on glazed tiles, sanitaryware and steel. No dilution, no mixing.

Spray, wait a few minutes, scrub lightly with a plastic brush and rinse with plenty of water. Wear gloves, keep the window open, and never mix it with other cleaners. Not for marble, granite or natural stone.

Pack of 2. Link in bio.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #homecare

A chair's backrest can only support a back that is actually touching it.

On the front edge of a chair, the lower back has nothing to lean on, so its muscles hold you up the whole time.

Slide the hips all the way back, and tuck a small rolled towel at the waist to fill the curve. Stop if anything hurts.

Which chair at home do you sit on the longest? Tell us in the comments.

#wellnessathome #familycare #indianparents #jointcare

A ceiling stain marks where water collected, so start your crack check right above it.

Swipe for an after-the-rains check: why now, look up first, look where two materials meet, then clean, dry and a thin coat.

Hairline cracks only; wider gaps need filling first. Not for gas or electrical work.

Save this post for the first dry weekend.

#homerepair #waterproofing #monsoonprep #homecare

Strong sunlight brightens white cotton but slowly fades coloured clothes.

Dry whites in the sun and colours in the shade.

Turn dyed clothes inside out and hang them where the sun doesn't fall directly.

Try it this weekend with the next wash.

#laundrytips #fabriccare #stainremoval #dailyuse

Almost every small letter starts at the top of the line, not the bottom.

Writing a, b, d, h and l from the top down is how most handwriting is taught. A child who starts some letters at the bottom has to relearn the stroke when writing joins up later.

The one exception is e, which starts in the middle. Next time, watch where the pencil lands first, not only how the letter looks.

Save this post for homework time.

#kidslearning #handwritingpractice #studyathome #indianparents

Sunlight through the same window slowly lightens the side of the almirah it falls on.

Finished wood fades a little wherever daylight reaches it, so a piece that never moves ends up two-toned over the years.

A curtain in the brightest hours, or turning the piece now and then, keeps the colour even.

Which piece in your home sits next to a window? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #homecare #madeforindia

Your bathroom is made of five different surfaces, and they don't all want the same care.

Glazed tiles shed water, so marks sit on top. Grout is porous and yellows first. Steel fittings hold marks in their scratches. Marble, granite and kota are etched by acids. The glazed sink and WC are cared for like tiles.

Swipe for what each one needs.

Save this post.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #dailyuse

A thick blob of sealant dries on the outside first and stays soft underneath for longer.

Two thin coats set all the way through: brush the first, let it dry, then brush the second.

Our Transparent Waterproof Glue comes with its own brush in the box, for small household leaks and cracks: pipe joints, tile gaps, hairline terrace cracks. It dries clear, stays flexible and is waterproof once cured. No mixing, no gun. Pack of 2.

For hairline cracks and joints; not for gas or electrical repairs. Link in bio.

Fingertips press hard into one small spot; a flat palm spreads the same pressure wide.

When you massage a parent's knee or shoulder, use the whole palm in slow, gentle strokes. It is more comfortable for them and easier on your own hands.

Stop if anything hurts.

Try it this weekend.

By the fifth copy down a column, a child is copying their own last try, not the model.

Any slip in one row repeats and grows in the next. Looking back up at the printed model before each try keeps the shape true.

Our Magic Practice Copybook puts the model shape under the pen on every row: grooved practice pages, self-fading ink so the pages can be used again, 4 books + 10 refills, and a pen with a finger grip. A practice aid.

Diya wax that has gone hard flakes off a cloth far more cleanly than soft wax.

Rubbing it while it is soft pushes it deeper into the weave. Hold an ice cube on it until it sets, then lift it off with a blunt knife.

Press the spot with a warm iron through a sheet of brown paper so the paper soaks up the rest, and treat any colour left behind before the wash. Test on a hidden seam first.

Save this post for Diwali week.

#stainremoval #laundrytips #fabriccare #madeforindia

Look at the spouts in your bathroom: the hot side usually carries more white crust.

Heating hard water pushes more of its dissolved minerals out, so the hot tap and the geyser outlet scale up first.

Wiping the hot tap's spout dry after the bath is the one habit that slows it.

Which tap crusts first in your home? Tell us in the comments.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #homecare

Wooden furniture wears first where daily life touches it: heat, oil and hands.

Before the festive cleaning, look at four spots: the mandir, the door edge by the handle, the dining table and the bed headboard.

Swipe for the simple habit for each: a metal plate under every diya, a barely damp wipe then dry, a trivet under the kadai, and a cotton cover on the headboard.

Walk round these four spots this weekend.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #dailyuse #shribazaar

A damp patch under a window usually starts below one of its two bottom corners.

Rain runs down the glass and the frame, collects on the sill, and finds the joint where the frame meets the wall at those corners.

After the rains, check the outside joint at the two bottom corners before anywhere else.

Link in bio for our brush-on waterproof glue for hairline cracks and joints.

Press a damp white cloth on a new kurta's inside seam. Colour on it? Wash it alone.

If colour comes off on the white cloth, the dye still bleeds, so wash that piece by itself for its first few washes.

If the cloth stays clean, the kurta can go in with the rest of the load.

Try it this weekend before the next festive wash.

#laundrytips #fabriccare #festiveseason #homecare

Massage just before bed, and whatever stays on the skin ends up on the pillow cover.

A greasy balm or oil keeps rubbing off on the bedsheet for hours. A gel that absorbs and dries without stickiness lets you lie down soon after.

Our Soothing Massage Gel is a cooling gel for knees, lower back, neck and shoulders. Fast-absorbing, non-sticky, and it comes as a pack of 2 jars. For external use only.

Put one drop of water on a wooden table: if it beads up, the finish there is intact.

If it soaks in and the wood darkens, the finish has worn through at that spot. Wipe the drop dry after the test.

Polish is for finished wood; a worn-through patch needs refinishing first.

Did yours bead or soak in? Tell us in the comments.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #homecare #dailyuse

Watch a child's pencil hand: the grip usually falls into one of four common patterns.

Swipe for the tripod, the four-finger grip, the thumb wrapped over, and the whole fist, and what each one means for the hand.

If writing is comfortable and readable, there is no need to force a change. Every hand settles in its own way.

When you look over your shoulder, the neck alone reaches the end of its turn quickly.

Turning the shoulders and chest along with it shares the movement, whether you are reversing a scooter or reaching for the back seat.

Move slowly, and stop if anything hurts.

Try it the next time you park the scooter.

#familycare #wellnessathome #indianparents #madeforindia

Look at a chipped edge: a glazed tile hides a different colour under its glaze.

Marble, granite and kota are the same colour and pattern all the way through. The cut side of a skirting piece shows the same thing.

It matters because acid-based cleaners suit glazed tile but etch natural stone. On stone, use plain water and mild soap only.

Save this post.

#bathroomcleaning #homecare #cleaninghacks #hardwaterstains

Wet kumkum spreads into the weave; lifted off dry with sticky tape, most of it comes away.

Pujas, garlands, sweets and mehendi each leave a different mark, and each has a different first step: lift the powder or pollen with tape, blot ghee with a tissue, let mehendi dry and scrape it.

Test anything on a hidden seam first.

Which festive mark turns up most at your home? Tell us in the comments.

#stainremoval #festiveseason #laundrytips #fabriccare

On a dining chair, the top rail of the backrest dulls before the seat does.

It is the spot hands grip every time the chair is pulled out, so the finish wears there first.

Our Wood & Furniture Polish is a beeswax spray for finished wood: dust, mist lightly one section at a time, then buff off along the grain with a dry cloth. It leaves a soft, low sheen, and light scratches look less visible. Pack of 2.

Tap along a bathroom wall with a knuckle: a hollow-sounding tile has come away behind.

Water that gets in through an open joint around that tile has room to sit behind it. Look along its grout and seal any gap you can see.

A loose tile needs refixing; sealing only keeps water out of the gaps.

Save this post for your next bathroom check.

#homerepair #waterproofing #monsoonprep #dailyuse

A bent knee keeps the muscles around it working, even while you massage it.

Rest the leg out straight with a rolled towel under the knee, so those muscles can let go, then massage slowly and gently.

Stop if anything hurts.

Try it this weekend.

#jointcare #familycare #wellnessathome #shribazaar

Every small English letter sits on one of three floors: sky, grass or roots.

Tall letters (b, d, f, h, k, l, t) climb into the sky. Small ones (a, c, e, m, n, o, r, s, u, v, w, x, z) stay on the grass. Tail letters (g, j, p, q, y) dig into the roots.

Naming the floor before writing a letter is a simple way to keep sizes even along a line.

Save this post.

#handwritingpractice #kidslearning #studyathome #shribazaar

Treat a stain from the back of the cloth, so it leaves the way it came in.

Working from the front drives the mark deeper through the weave; from the back it has the shortest way out.

Our All in One Fabric Stain Remover is a liquid spot treatment for before the wash: wet the mark, cover it, leave it a few minutes, then wash as usual. No scrubbing. For haldi, chai, oil and collar marks. Pack of 2.

Helps lift everyday marks. Test on a hidden seam first. Link in bio.

A shower spraying thin jets sideways usually has scaled nozzles, not low water pressure.

Hard water leaves mineral in the small holes until some close and others squirt off at an angle.

On a shower head with soft rubber nozzles, rubbing each one with your thumb loosens the flakes.

Does your shower spray straight? Tell us in the comments.

#bathroomcleaning #hardwaterstains #cleaninghacks #homecare

Three tables can look alike from the top. The edge tells you what they are made of.

Solid wood: the grain carries on round the edge. Veneer: a thin wood layer on board, so the edge strip does not match the top. Laminate: a repeating print and water just sits on it. Painted: the colour is a coating.

Polish is for finished wood, solid or veneer. Laminate and painted surfaces only need a damp cloth and a dry wipe.

Check the edge of your dining table this weekend.

#furniturecare #woodpolish #dailyuse #shribazaar

A white crust on a pipe joint is a slow leak that dries before it ever drips.

Each seep leaves its minerals behind, so the crust grows right where the joint weeps.

The test: after the tap has run, wrap a dry tissue round the joint. A damp patch on the tissue finds the spot.

Have you found one of these at home? Tell us in the comments.

#homerepair #waterproofing #monsoonprep #homecare

The weed that bleeds white.

Asthma weed (Euphorbia hirta) is the low, spreading weed with reddish stems that turns up in path cracks, at the edge of paving and on bare ground. Its small oval leaves sit in pairs, with tiny round flower clusters in the leaf joints. Snap a stem and a milky white sap beads out at the break: that is how you know it.

The sap irritates skin and eyes. Wear gloves when you clear it, and keep your hands away from your face until you have washed.

உடைத்தால் பால் வடியும் களை.

Have you seen it in your path cracks? Tell us where it grows at your place.

#களை #tamilnadu #weedidentification #growandguard

Pull doob slowly and the runner comes out longer.

Doob spreads by runners that creep along the soil and root at every joint. A fast yank snaps the runner at its first joint, and the rest stays in the ground to regrow. A slow, steady pull with teeth hooked under it lifts more of the runner along its length.

The BAGIYA weeding rake head has five pointed carbon-steel teeth, 14 cm long and 20 cm wide, that hook under runners and loosen the soil in the same pull. Handle not included; it fits a standard wooden pole.

दूब को धीरे खींचें।

Share this with whoever weeds your kitchen garden. 🌱

#बागवानी #weeding #gardeningtools #bagiya

Not every grass on your path is doob.

Three grasses look alike from a distance. The seed head tells them apart:
1. Doob (Bermuda grass): fine leaves on runners along the ground; a seed head of 3 to 5 thin fingers from one point.
2. Crowfoot grass: a few short, thick spikes spread flat like a bird's foot, each ending in a bare point.
3. Goosegrass: a flat clump with a pale, silvery centre and zipper-like spikes; its roots grip hard, so it is very hard to pull by hand.

No seed head yet? Look at how it grows: runners, a loose tuft, or a flat clump with a pale centre.

Weeds ring a plant at its leaf edge, not its stem.

Rain runs off a plant's leaves and drips at the outer edge of its canopy, and light reaches the soil there too. So weed seedlings come up in a ring under the leaf tips, while the shaded soil at the stem often stays bare. Weed that ring first, then work outward from it.

The strip between the tyre tracks greens first.

On a gravel or mud driveway, the two wheel tracks are crushed every day. The middle strip is never driven or walked on, so seeds settle there and grow undisturbed. That is why the centre line turns green long before the rest.

Palak seedlings look like weeds for their first week.

In a freshly sown bed, the first leaves of palak, methi and dhaniya are small and plain, and they are easy to pull by mistake along with the weeds around them.

Two habits fix it:
1. Weed before you sow, while every green in the bed is a weed.
2. Mark each row with a string between two sticks, or a line of sticks, so you know which green is yours. Anything off the line can go.
